risks.title: Increased competition in the real estate sector
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in a central position in the 10-K, with strong language on competitive pressure. The trend is stable, but the 'Competition' category is strategic for the brokerage business. The risk is repeated in the risk factors summary.

risks.title: Dependence on proprietary technology
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, with strong language on the importance of the Compass platform. The trend is stable, but system failure would have a critical impact. Technology is core to the business model.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data-related risks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 1C and repeated in the summary. Alarmist language ('loss of critical information'), stable trend, high weight due to handling of sensitive data. Potential impact is major.

risks.title: Dependence on independent agents
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well-positioned in the 10-K, with language emphasizing reliance on agents. Trend is stable, but crucial as the model depends on their performance. Mentioned repeatedly in multiple sections.

risks.title: Integration of the Christie’s International Real Estate network
risks.score_rationale: The risk is new in the 10-K (acquisition in January 2025), with cautious language on integration. Trend is 'new', high weight as it represents a new strategic line. Mentioned in Item 1.

risks.title: Adoption of artificial intelligence
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the 10-K with cautious language ('our ability to integrate'). Mid-level positioning, but trend is rising. AI is strategic for technological differentiation.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party vendors
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the 10-K with moderate language. Mid-level positioning, stable trend. Less critical than others, but present in key processes such as title or escrow.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned, with concerned language about rights protection. Trend is stable, high weight as the platform is a strategic asset. Linked to technological differentiation.

ai_positioning.summary: Compass is gradually integrating artificial intelligence and machine learning tools into its platform to enhance customer experience and agent efficiency. Focus is on automating administrative tasks, predictive pricing analytics, and content generation.
